data.summary: Finance Operations professional with 10 years' experience delivering CASS 6,7 and 10-aligned Client Money and Custody Asset controls for UK-regulated business. Track record of resolving reconciliation breaks, strengthening audit and regulatory readiness and driving automation that cuts manual effort. Skilled at coordinating across New Business, Trade Support, Claims, and external service teams to keep client asset records and breaks accurate and on schedule. Looking to bring this CASS depth and stakeholder- management experience into Team Leader role.

raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Finance Operations professional with 10 years' experience delivering CASS 6,7 and 10-aligned Client Money and Custody Asset controls for UK-regulated business. Track record of resolving reconciliation breaks, strengthening audit and regulatory readiness and driving automation that cuts manual effort. Skilled at coordinating across New Business, Trade Support, Claims, and external service teams to keep client asset records and breaks accurate and on schedule. Looking to bring this CASS depth and stakeholder- management experience into Team Leader role.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
CASS 6, 7 & 10 Compliance • CMAR / Regulatory Reporting
Client Money & Custody Reconciliation • Audit & Control Evidence
Break Investigation & Exception Mgmt. • Process Automation & Migration
Stakeholder Coordination
Autorek, CREST, Sonata, Frontier
Team Quality Review & Coaching
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
CASS SME — Finance Operations | M&G India — Powai, Mumbai • Contribute to process-improvement initiatives that reduce manual effort and raise control discipline across the CASS function
2021 – Present
[1.23 FTE cost saved].
Led a team of 6 as Acting Team Leader. Managed daily operations and team deliverables in the absence of the Reporting Manager for 1 quarter. Recognized with “Thank You Award” for effective team handling and business continuity.
Hands on experience in FTE Calculation, monthly reporting on process improvements, production metrics and performance analysis.
Resolve daily Bank Debit/Credit shortfalls under CASS 7, funding unallocated and unidentified payments/receipts to keep client money accurately segregated.
Run daily Custody CREST reconciliation in Autorek, matching custody records against CREST-settled deals to catch discrepancies before they escalate.
Own monthly Custody reconciliation under CASS 6, delivering management-ready Cash and Custody summaries on schedule.
Partner with New Business, Claims, Dividends, Trade Support, and external service teams to clear shortfall breaks, keeping CASS delivery on track.
Specialist — Finance Services Operations (S3) | DST Worldwide Services India Pvt. Ltd. — Airoli, Navi Mumbai Jul 2020 – Apr 2021
Delivered reconciliation, reporting, and operational control support across finance operations and client-asset processes, escalating unresolved exceptions within service-level timelines.
Prepared audit-ready documentation for control reviews, governance forums, and management reporting.
Worked directly with IT to automate Frontier reconciliation workflows, streamlining daily processing.
Led migration of new and changed processes into BAU, improving knowledge-sharing and execution consistency across the team.
Senior Associate (E2) | Syntel Services Pvt. Ltd. — Airoli, Navi Mumbai • Prepared monthly CMAR reports under CASS 10 for Management Companies' FCA submissions, ensuring accurate, on-time
Oct 2015 – Jun 2020
regulatory reporting [add: e.g., 100% on-time submission rate].
Investigated reconciliation differences and applied corrective fund movements, correctly allocating deals received into the Corporate Account.
Reconciled Bank Book to Cash Book daily, investigating payments and protecting unidentified receipts and fund shortfalls for unallocated payments.
Managed the Client Money Account end-to-end, tracking unallocated client money to maintain FCA-compliant segregation.
• Quality-checked processor output before submission, catching errors upstream and lifting team accuracy.
KEY ACHIEVEMENTS
Strengthened reconciliation quality by identifying recurring break patterns and driving corrective actions across the CASS process.
Improved exception-resolution timeliness through clearer tracking, escalation, and stakeholder follow-up.
Supported audit and control readiness by maintaining complete evidence, documentation, and review records.
Drove process improvements that reduced manual effort, improved accuracy, and raised CASS control discipline.
Recognised with multiple performance awards, including Titan of the Month, AGILE Value Award, and Champ of the Month.
Introduction to Securities & Investment — Chartered Institute for Securities & Investment (CISI)
raw_sections.education: Post Graduate Diploma in Financial Management — NMIMS
